summary: Added an internal DelegateSlot command that reuses governed route revision CAS while replacing exactly one frozen seat. The owner validates the delegation metadata, current Human assignment, responsibility type, request/workspace scope and limited expiry before fresh decisions are created. Approved history remains immutable, pending seats are superseded, and ALL completion only occurs after every fresh seat responds.
boundaries: Production reviewer qualification and governance assembly remain externally bounded
Escalation chains, capability-correction candidates and broader exception successor orchestration remain open
